rule: Upgrade existing employees through reusable skills and measured role loops before adding headcount. Skill attachment never grants tool, connector, or provider authority.

loops.focus: delegation closure and recurring blocker routing
loops.observe: orphaned work, stalled handoffs, unresolved ownership
loops.practice: route with owner/deadline/evidence and follow-up receipts
loops.measure: handoff closure rate and orphaned-task reduction

loops.observe: metric-definition disputes, missing provenance, forecast assumptions
loops.practice: tie KPI conclusions to source provenance and sensitivity evidence
loops.measure: forecast correction rate and unsupported-metric findings

loops.observe: integration regressions, undocumented source assumptions, CI drift
loops.practice: attach source/provenance evidence to codebase verification and rollback decisions
loops.measure: regressions caught before merge and provenance completeness

loops.observe: good research without explicit closure/verification conditions
loops.measure: reopened research tasks and unsupported completion claims

loops.observe: strong concepts that lack execution checklist or proof
loops.practice: plan-execute-review creative outputs before completion claims
loops.measure: revision cycles and claim/brand QA misses

loops.observe: large evidence sets with fragmented conclusions
loops.practice: synthesize evidence into traceable decision briefs before QA verdicts

loops.observe: creative/audience changes without normalized KPI framing
loops.practice: pair Meta Ads operations with KPI definition and post-change measurement

loops.observe: keyword/bid changes without explicit hypothesis or stopping rule
loops.practice: frame bounded experiments before approved Google Ads mutations
loops.measure: experiments with hypothesis, guardrail, and readback

loops.observe: audits with many findings but weak prioritization narrative
loops.practice: synthesize multi-source audit evidence into ranked decision rationale

loops.observe: connector behavior that depends on undocumented provider/source assumptions
loops.practice: record source provenance alongside MCP/integration contracts
loops.measure: integration incidents attributable to missing provenance

loops.observe: metric outputs whose source lineage is hard to reconstruct
loops.practice: attach source provenance to data analysis and experiment evaluation

loops.observe: follow-ups marked done without explicit completion evidence
loops.measure: stale commitments and reopened completed tasks

loops.observe: automations that run but do not prove value or safe completion
loops.practice: verify automation result before declaring queue optimization complete

loops.observe: well-compressed context that may omit acceptance evidence
loops.practice: verify protected atoms, source integrity, and acceptance before completion

loops.observe: closure claims detached from original commitment/evidence
loops.practice: preserve provenance for follow-up receipts and escalations

loops.observe: draft outreach/community actions treated as finished without receipt
loops.practice: verify delivery/result evidence before completion claims
